name: Mentha
headline: Mentha - Control Brand Narrative in AI Engines
short_description: Mentha is an AEO/GEO platform that audits, measures, and optimizes how conversational AIs talk about your brand. It doesn't do traditional SEO. It doesn't generate "SEO content". It controls your brand narrative across the new AI frontiers: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini.
author: beenruuu

sections.overview:
Mentha is the first open-source Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform designed to track how conversational AI systems mention and recommend your brand. Unlike traditional SEO tools built for search engines, Mentha uses real browser automation to capture how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini discuss your brand, then evaluates results using an LLM-as-Judge system. The platform measures Share of Voice against competitors, analyzes sentiment, tracks citations, identifies hallucinations, and extracts knowledge graphs from AI responses. It helps marketing teams monitor brand visibility across the new AI frontier, discover link opportunities from AI citations, and optimize their brand narrative where 500M+ users now get answers daily.
Monitor how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini mention your brand in AI-generated answers
Measure Share of Voice against competitors across multiple AI answer engines
Analyze sentiment and detect negative brand mentions in AI responses
Track citations and sources from AI engines to identify link-building opportunities
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/beenruuu/Mentha`
sections.usage:
```
Analyze how [COMPANY] is currently represented in conversational AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity. Identify key areas where the brand narrative can be improved or optimized. Provide specific recommendations for enhancing brand consistency and messaging across these platforms.
```

requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
